subject: Re: Next steps — PoC and deployment mode for AcmeCorp
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — PoC and deployment mode for AcmeCorp

Hi Alex — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from today's discovery so we can align on the PoC scope and deployment mode.

Summary of needs you mentioned:
- Production latency target: 50–150ms p90 for single-user inference (chat endpoint).
- Peak throughput: ~200 concurrent users, bursts to 500 for product launches.
- Data isolation/compliance: must meet internal controls and be auditable (no external mixing of customer data).
- Enterprise integrations: SSO + customer-managed KMS for key material is desired.

Deployment mode options (short):
- Hosted API: fastest to ship, multi-tenant, lower cost but not customer-managed keys.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pool in our infra — predictable throughput, isolated tenancy, can integrate with some KMS workflows.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): full network isolation and customer-controlled infrastructure for strict compliance.

From our call, Dedicated capacity seems like the leading option, but wanted to confirm. Proposed PoC/trial plan:
1) Goal: Validate throughput/latency under your query distribution and confirm integration with your KMS for key management.
2) Success criteria (examples to confirm): p90 latency <= 150ms, sustained throughput of 200 concurrent users, model output quality passes your acceptance prompts (we'll run your eval set).
3) Timeline: 3-week technical PoC (1 week setup/integration, 1 week load & tuning, 1 week evaluation + handoff).
4) Stakeholders we need: technical owner (infra), ML lead for evals, procurement/contract owner.

Can you confirm: (a) deployment mode preference, (b) primary technical contact for the PoC, and (c) any hard deadline for the PoC completion?

Attachments: redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx (PoC milestones and required info).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 20-min sync if helpful.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Meera Shah <meera.shah@acmecorp.com>, Jordan Alvarez <j.alvarez@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — PoC and deployment mode for AcmeCorp

Thanks Ben — appreciated the summary. Quick answers below.

1) Deployment mode: We prefer Dedicated capacity. Key reasons: predictable performance for our SLAs and tenancy isolation. We would consider Private only if Legal pushes for full on-prem, but that is a last resort.

2) Technical contact for PoC: Jordan Alvarez (Infra lead) — j.alvarez@acmecorp.com. He will handle network and KMS coordination.

3) ML/quality contact: Meera Shah (head of ML) — she will provide the eval prompts and acceptance tests.

4) Timeline / deadline: We'd like the PoC completed before our internal architecture review on Nov 30; 3-week PoC starting mid-Nov would be fine.

I'll loop in Legal if we need a quick SOW — they prefer a short PoC SOW and an NDA addendum for KMS integration.

Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Product, AcmeCorp
alex.johnson@acmecorp.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — PoC and deployment mode for AcmeCorp

Hi Alex — great, thanks for confirming. A few technical clarifications so we can size Dedicated properly and prepare the PoC environment:

- Do you have a preferred GPU family (A100/H100) or should we recommend based on your latency/throughput targets?
- For KMS: do you require our integration with your cloud KMS (we support AWS KMS, GCP KMS) or will you use an HSM on your side?
- Network: do you require VPC peering or a private endpoint (PrivateLink)?
- Model/weights: will you supply a fine-tuned model or do you want us to use a Redwood-curated base model for the PoC? If you have model artifacts, please share a download link.

Attaching the PoC checklist (redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx) — please fill the highlighted fields (KMS details, expected sequence length, sample QPS profile, and eval set location). Once we have that, we can provision Dedicated nodes and propose exact instance types.

Proposed PoC kickoff window: week of Nov 16 — does that still work for your team?

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Meera Shah <meera.shah@acmecorp.com>, Jordan Alvarez <j.alvarez@acmecorp.com>, legal@acmecorp.com
Date: 2026-11-01T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — PoC and deployment mode for AcmeCorp

Camila — thanks. Quick answers inline and attached SOW.

- GPU family: start with A100 (we've historically used A100 and want to evaluate cost/latency).
- KMS: we will provide an AWS KMS key; please confirm Redwood's process for using customer-managed keys (we expect a proof of key usage and audit log).
- Network: PrivateLink preferred.
- Model: we'll use your Redwood-curated base model for the PoC; Meera will provide a small fine-tuned checkpoint later if needed.

Attached: acmecorp-poc-sow-signed.pdf (signed by procurement). Please confirm next steps for provisioning and send DocuSign/invoice if needed.

Alex

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Next steps — PoC and deployment mode for AcmeCorp

Alex — fantastic, thanks for the quick turnaround and for the signed SOW. Next steps from our side: 

1) Camila will provision Dedicated nodes with A100s and set up a PrivateLink endpoint. Camila — can you target Nov 16 for infra provisioning?
2) Jordan — we will request the AWS KMS key ARN and follow our customer-managed key onboarding checklist.
3) Meera — please upload the eval prompts to the shared Drive link in the HubSpot record, or reply here with a link.
4) I'll kick off the DocuSign invoice flow and share the payment/PO instructions — expected billing contact is procurement@acmecorp.com per the SOW.

Kickoff meeting: Tue Nov 16 at 10am PT — invite sent. Agenda attached: redwood-poc-kickoff-agenda.docx.

If anything urgent comes up, loop me in. Looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Ben Carter
